items.q: We ______ football in the park when it suddenly started to pour.
items.vi: Chúng tôi đang chơi bóng đá trong công viên thì trời bỗng đổ mưa như trút.
items.explanation: A longer action in progress that is interrupted by a shorter past action (started) takes the past continuous: were playing.

items.q: We moved to a quiet ______ near the river, where all the neighbours know each other.
items.vi: Chúng tôi chuyển đến một khu dân cư yên tĩnh gần bờ sông, nơi hàng xóm đều quen biết nhau.
items.explanation: A neighbourhood is the small residential area around your home. A region or territory is a large part of a country, and a zone is an area set aside for a purpose (a no-parking zone).

items.q: Please ______ attention to the safety rules before you start the chemistry experiment.
items.vi: Hãy chú ý đến các quy tắc an toàn trước khi bạn bắt đầu thí nghiệm hóa học.
items.explanation: The fixed collocation is pay attention (to). Give, take and put do not combine with attention: we give advice, take notes and put effort into something.

items.q: Now that Mr Ba is retiring, he wants to ______ and let the younger teachers run the football club.
items.vi: Giờ sắp nghỉ hưu, thầy Ba muốn lui về phía sau và để các giáo viên trẻ điều hành câu lạc bộ bóng đá.
items.explanation: To take a back seat is to stop leading and let others take charge. To take the floor is to start speaking, to take a stand is to defend an opinion, and to take a rain check is to postpone an invitation.

items.q: My grandparents still live in the small town ______ my father grew up.
items.vi: Ông bà tôi vẫn sống ở thị trấn nhỏ nơi bố tôi lớn lên.
items.explanation: The relative adverb where replaces 'in the town' and is followed by a full clause (my father grew up). Which would need a preposition (in which) because 'grew up' has no object, and who and whose refer to people.

items.q: Lan: How did you ______ that the test was cancelled? / Nam: Our teacher posted it in the class group.
items.vi: Lan: Sao cậu biết được là bài kiểm tra bị hủy? / Nam: Cô giáo đăng trong nhóm lớp.
items.explanation: To find out is to discover a fact. Look out means be careful, make out means see or hear with difficulty, and turn out means happen in the end.

items.q: The streets are all wet this morning. It ______ have rained during the night.
items.vi: Sáng nay đường phố ướt hết cả. Chắc hẳn đêm qua trời đã mưa.
items.explanation: Must have + past participle expresses a confident conclusion about the past based on evidence (the wet streets). Can't have would mean the opposite, and should and needn't do not express deduction.

items.q: The little shelter at the bus ______ outside our school keeps us dry when it rains.
items.vi: Mái che nhỏ ở trạm xe buýt trước cổng trường giúp chúng tôi khỏi bị ướt khi trời mưa.
items.explanation: A bus stop is the small roadside place where a bus picks people up. A station or terminal is a large building where many routes start and end, and a harbour is for ships.

items.q: By the time the bus finally came, we ______ for over half an hour.
items.vi: Đến lúc xe buýt cuối cùng cũng tới, chúng tôi đã đợi hơn nửa tiếng.
items.explanation: By the time + past simple points to an action completed before that past moment, which takes the past perfect: had waited.

items.q: There is ______ traffic on this road in the early morning, so we usually get to school on time.
items.vi: Sáng sớm đường này rất ít xe cộ, nên chúng tôi thường đến trường đúng giờ.
items.explanation: Traffic is uncountable, so it takes little (= not much). Few, a few and many only go with plural countable nouns.

items.q: Nam usually ______ his homework right after dinner so he can watch TV later.
items.vi: Nam thường làm bài tập về nhà ngay sau bữa tối để lát nữa được xem tivi.
items.explanation: The fixed collocation is do homework. Make is used for creating things (make a cake, make a decision), and work needs a preposition (work on).

items.q: If it ______ so cold today, we would go for a walk along the river.
items.vi: Nếu hôm nay trời không lạnh thế này thì chúng tôi sẽ đi dạo dọc bờ sông.
items.explanation: An unreal present situation (it IS cold) takes the second conditional: if + past subjunctive (weren't) with would in the main clause. Hadn't been would refer to the past.

items.q: There is a small ______ in the middle of town where people sit and feed the pigeons.
items.vi: Có một quảng trường nhỏ ở giữa thị trấn, nơi mọi người ngồi cho bồ câu ăn.
items.explanation: A square is an open public space in a town. A yard belongs to a house or school, a block is a group of buildings between streets, and a corner is where two streets meet, not a place to sit.

items.q: Our old school bus ______ on the way to the museum, so we arrived an hour late.
items.vi: Chiếc xe buýt cũ của trường bị hỏng giữa đường đến bảo tàng, nên chúng tôi tới muộn một tiếng.
items.explanation: A vehicle or machine breaks down when it stops working. Break up is to end a relationship or the school term, break out is to start suddenly (a fire, a war), and make up is to invent a story.

items.q: Lan has practised the piano every day for months; ______, she played beautifully at the school concert.
items.vi: Lan đã luyện đàn piano mỗi ngày suốt nhiều tháng; vì vậy, cô ấy chơi rất hay trong buổi hòa nhạc của trường.
items.explanation: Playing beautifully is the result of months of practice, so we need therefore. However shows a contrast, otherwise means 'if not', and meanwhile means 'at the same time'.

items.q: Lan: Have you finished your maths homework? / Nam: Not yet. I ______ the last two problems.
items.vi: Lan: Cậu làm xong bài tập toán chưa? / Nam: Chưa. Tớ vẫn chưa làm hai bài cuối.
items.explanation: Not yet describes an unfinished action up to now, which takes the present perfect: haven't done. The past simple didn't do would need a finished past time.

items.q: Before opening a second shop, Mrs Hoa decided to ______ by selling her cakes at the weekend market.
items.vi: Trước khi mở cửa hàng thứ hai, cô Hoa quyết định thăm dò thị trường bằng cách bán bánh ở chợ cuối tuần.
items.explanation: To test the waters is to try something in a small way before committing to it. Break the ice is to make people relax when they first meet, hit the road is to set off, and clear the air is to end a misunderstanding.

items.q: Turn left at the ______ where Nguyen Trai Street meets Le Loi Street, and the school is on your right.
items.vi: Rẽ trái ở ngã tư nơi đường Nguyễn Trãi giao với đường Lê Lợi, trường ở bên tay phải.
items.explanation: A junction is the place where two roads meet. A lane is a narrow road, the pavement is where people walk beside the road, and a bridge crosses a river or another road.

items.q: Lan: ______ I borrow your ruler for a minute? / Nam: Sure, here you are.
items.vi: Lan: Tớ mượn thước của cậu một lát được không? / Nam: Được chứ, đây này.
items.explanation: Could I…? is the polite way to ask for permission. Must I asks about obligation, Should I asks for advice, and Would I borrow is not a request.

items.q: Remember ______ your raincoat tomorrow; it looks like a storm is coming.
items.vi: Nhớ mang áo mưa ngày mai nhé; có vẻ bão sắp đến rồi.
items.explanation: Remember to do means not to forget a task you still have to do. Remember doing refers to a memory of something already done, which does not fit 'tomorrow'.

items.q: The new bridge, ______ opened last month, has cut my journey to school in half.
items.vi: Cây cầu mới, mới thông xe tháng trước, đã rút ngắn quãng đường đến trường của tôi một nửa.
items.explanation: A non-defining relative clause (between commas) about a thing takes which; that cannot follow a comma. Where needs a full clause after it, and what is not a relative pronoun.

items.q: Hurry up, or we'll ______ the school bus again and have to walk!
items.vi: Nhanh lên, không thì chúng ta lại lỡ xe buýt của trường và phải đi bộ đấy!
items.explanation: You miss a bus, train or plane when you arrive too late for it. Lose the bus is a direct translation that English does not use.

items.q: ______ had we left the house when it began to snow.
items.vi: Chúng tôi vừa mới ra khỏi nhà thì tuyết bắt đầu rơi.
items.explanation: Hardly + had + subject + past participle… when is the inverted pattern. No sooner needs than, not when, and Not until and Only do not fit this structure.

items.q: Sa Pa is a favourite ______ for tourists who want to see snow in winter.
items.vi: Sa Pa là điểm đến yêu thích của du khách muốn ngắm tuyết vào mùa đông.
items.explanation: A destination is the place people travel to. A journey is the trip itself, a direction is the way you go, and an arrival is the act of reaching a place.

items.q: This time next week, we ______ on the beach in Nha Trang instead of sitting in class.
items.vi: Giờ này tuần sau, chúng tôi sẽ đang nằm trên bãi biển Nha Trang thay vì ngồi trong lớp.
items.explanation: This time next week points to an action in progress at a future moment, which takes the future continuous: will be lying.
